description: On Intel-based macOS systems, the Okta Device Access (ODA) component of Okta Verify for macOS configures a LaunchDaemon service that uses a symbolic link in /usr/local/bin for its program path. If local non-root users have write permissions to this directory, they can modify the symbolic link target. This allows execution of an arbitrary binary when the LaunchDaemon service restarts.
